typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet = CAST((MEMBERID + \',\' + CIN + \',\' + FIRSTNAME + \',\' + MIDDLENAME + \',\' + LASTNAME + \',\' + LASTNAME2 + \',\' + ADDRESS + \',\' + ADDRESS2 + \',\' + CITY + \',\' + STATE + \',\' + ZIP + \',\' +  	    FIPS + \',\' + COUNTY + \',\' + PHONE + \',\' + PHONETYPE + \',\' + EMAIL + \',\' + GENDER + \',\' + SEX + \',\' + CONTACTPREFERENCE + \',\' + DOB + \',\' + AGE + \',\' + RACE + \',\' +  		ETHNICITY + \',\' + SEXUALORIENTATION + \',\' + LANGUAGE + \',\' + WRITTENLANGUAGE + \',\' + PCPASSIGNED + \',\' + PCPFIRSTNAME + \',\' + PCPLASTNAME + \',\' + PCPPHONE + \',\' +  		PCPADDRESS + \',\' + PCPADDRESS2 + \',\' + PCPCITY + \',\' + PCPSTATE + \',\' + PCPZIP + \',\' + PCPLANGUAGE + \',\' + LASTPCPVISIT + \',\' + LASTWELLVISIT + \',\' +  		HEALTHPLAN + \',\' + ENROLLMENTDATE + \',\' + TERMDATE + \',\' + INITIALENROLLMENTYEAR + \',\' + DNC_PHONE + \',\' + DNT_PHONE + \',\' + DNE_EMAIL + \',\' + DNC + \',\' +  		REMOVE + \',\' + PREGNANCY_TERMINATION_DATE 	   ) AS VARCHAR(MAX))   FROM EXTRACT.SameSky_IA_Stg_Member  WHERE (ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\'     OR  RECORD_UPDATED_DT = CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),111)) ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetMemberExclusionData
GetMemberExclusionData derive(ResultSet = ResultSet) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> CultureGuideMemberExclusionFileOutbound
